environment.description: Same EC2 instance type but application deployed as a container with rootfs mounted read-only (docker run --read-only). No tmpfs volumes or emptyDir mounts are configured for the container. The container's entrypoint does not call os.makedirs. The EMAIL_SPOOL_DIR path (/var/spool/mailqueue) exists in the image as an empty directory but is non-writable at runtime due to the read-only overlay. SMTP_HOST environment variable points to an internal relay (internal-smtp.corp.local) that performs RFC 5322 strict header validation and rejects messages containing bare CR or LF characters in any header field. The relay runs Haraka with the headers plugin configured with reject_invalid_headers=true and strict_rfc5322=true.

config.smtp_relay: internal-smtp.corp.local (Haraka 2.8.28 with headers plugin: reject_invalid_headers=true, strict_rfc5322=true)
config.smtp_relay_config_note: Haraka headers plugin validates all header fields conform to RFC 5322 Section 2.2 - rejects messages where any header contains characters outside the printable ASCII range or contains unfolded CRLF sequences that would constitute header injection
config.filesystem: overlay2 rootfs mounted read-only, no writable layers
